component.name: GroupScaleReviewScene
component.script:
sub init() m.seq = 0 eff = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Effect") if eff <> invalid eff.borderRadius = [30, 30, 30, 30] m.top.findNode("p2e").effect = eff m.effect = "yes" else m.effect = "no" end if
tg = m.top.findNode("tg4") ts = CreateObject("roSGNode", "TargetSet") ts.targetRects = [{x: 0, y: 0, width: 200, height: 200}, {x: 240, y: 0, width: 200, height: 200}] tg.targetSet = ts tc = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to 1 item = tc.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = "T" + itos(i) end for tg.content = tc
ll = m.top.findNode("ll4") lc = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to 2 item = lc.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = "List item " + itos(i) end for ll.content = lc
ps = m.top.findNode("ps4") panel = ps.createChild("Panel") panel.id = "pn4" panel.panelSize = "medium" m.panel = panel fill = panel.createChild("Rectangle") fill.id = "bx4" fill.width = 300 fill.height = 300 fill.color = "0x40E040FF"
m.settleTimer = m.top.findNode("settleTimer") m.settleTimer.observeField("fire", "onSettled") m.settleTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onSettled() p("R2", "effect", "supported=" + m.effect) rects("R1", ["g1a", "l1a", "g1b", "r1b", "g1c", "gg1c", "r1c", "r1d", "l1d", "g1e", "r1e", "l1e"]) rects("R2", ["p2", "r2", "p2e"]) rects("R3", ["r3a", "c3a", "r3b", "p3c", "c3c", "l3d"]) rects("R4", ["tg4", "ll4", "ps4"]) if m.panel <> invalid p("R4", "pn4", "local=" + r(m.panel.localBoundingRect()) + " parent=" + r(m.panel.boundingRect()) + " scene=" + r(m.panel.sceneBoundingRect())) bx = m.panel.findNode("bx4") if bx <> invalid then p("R4", "bx4", "local=" + r(bx.localBoundingRect()) + " parent=" + r(bx.boundingRect()) + " scene=" + r(bx.sceneBoundingRect())) end if ll = m.top.findNode("ll4") for i = 0 to 2 key = "item" + itos(i) p("R4", "ll4", key + " scene=" + r(ll.sceneSubBoundingRect(key))) end for p("all", "done", "") m.top.probeExit = true end sub
sub rects(caseId as string, ids as object) for each id in ids node = m.top.findNode(id) if node = invalid p(caseId, id, "<not found>") else p(caseId, id, "local=" + r(node.localBoundingRect()) + " parent=" + r(node.boundingRect()) + " scene=" + r(node.sceneBoundingRect())) end if end for end sub
function r(rect as object) as string if rect = invalid then return "<invalid>" out = "{x=" + n(rect.x) out = out + " y=" + n(rect.y) out = out + " w=" + n(rect.width) out = out + " h=" + n(rect.height) return out + "}" end function
function n(v as dynamic) as string if v = invalid then return "?" if v >= 0 then return itos(int(v + 0.5)) return itos(-int(-v + 0.5)) end function
function itos(i as integer) as string return str(i).trim() end function
sub p(caseId as string, nodeId as string, detail as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = itos(m.seq) while s.len() < 3 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + caseId + "|" + nodeId + "|" + detail end sub
